comment: Choral - a choir that sings the note your synth plays (folder and source keep the working name "formant"). Rewritten 2026-10-07: a pitch tracker follows the input (one note at a time) and 1..6 singers (band-limited saws in their section's register, each with its own detune and vibrato) sing it through three vowel formants per section. Levels are fixed, so every synth gets the same choir; the voice follows the input's loudness. Tempo-synced movement (Pace) with bar-aware restarts and the bar tag. For synths, never drums or guitar. Footswitch off = bypass. Mono.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 494 SyncEQ, 495 GridDly, 496 Sweep (this pack; 492 was used by a dropped effect, 498 and 499 by the probes). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Choir
params.comment: Who sings: 0 MEN (on your note), 1 WOMEN (an octave up), 2 KIDS (two octaves up), 3 GIANT (an octave down), 4 M+W, 5 M+KID, 6 W+KID, 7 G+M, 8 G+W, 9 G+KID, 10 M+W+K, 11 G+M+W, 12 G+M+K, 13 G+W+K, 14 ALL (men, women, giants, kids), 15 MONKS (men and giants, straight tone without vibrato, dark, little breath), 16 GOSPL (men and women, wide vibrato, bright, breathy). Each section has its own throat size, darkness, breath and vibrato. Singers are dealt to the sections in turn. Default M+W.

params.name: Size
params.comment: How many sing: SOLO DUO TRIO QUART QUINT SEXT (1..6 singers). Every singer is a few cents apart with its own vibrato and drift; a bigger choir spreads wider and the extra singers come in a little late. Default TRIO.

params.name: Chord
params.comment: How they sing together. 0 UNIS (all on the note) and steps up to the octave, every second singer that many semitones (piano keys) up: 1 +1 .. 11 +11 (+7 is a 5th), 12 OCT. Chords, tones dealt to the singers in order (a small choir sings the first ones: root, then the 3rd or 2nd/4th, then the 5th): 13 MAJ, 14 MIN, 15 SUS2, 16 SUS4, 17 DIM, 18 AUG, 19 MAJ7, 20 MIN7, 21 DOM7, 22 ADD9, 23 OPEN (root, 5th, 10th). 24 DRONE: every second singer holds the first note of the phrase while the others follow you. Same shape on every note (parallel, no key). Default UNIS.

params.name: Sing
params.comment: What they sing: 0 AAH, 1 EHH, 2 EEE, 3 OHH, 4 OOH, 5 MMM (hum), 6 OOAH (opens from oo to ah and closes again once per Pace cycle), 7 VOWL (A E I O U, one vowel per Pace cycle), 8 LA, 9 DOO (a syllable once on every new note: l opening to ah, or a short stop and eh closing to oo; Pace sets how long the vowel takes to open or close), 10 SWELL (the choir breathes in and out once per Pace cycle), 11 CANON (sections come in one after another, each singing what you played one Pace cycle later, up to 3 cycles and 1 s per step). Default OOAH.

params.name: Feel
params.comment: 0 = soft and legato (slow attack and release, wide vibrato that fades in late, breathy, dark) .. 100 = punchy and staccato (fast attack and release, narrow vibrato, bright; OOAH snaps between its two vowels). Default 40.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: 0 = every note starts fresh, legato or not (fast arps). 1..100 = legato: the voice slides to a new note in about 3 ms .. 0.6 s, the same time for every interval. After a silence the next note starts directly. Default 20.

params.name: Tempo
params.comment: BPM for Pace (40..240), shown on screen. Flipping to the twin copy of the same BPM (120 <-> 321) marks a downbeat: the movement goes to where it should be that many bars after the last downbeat, so long and dotted Paces are never cut. A plain tempo change only changes the speed. SYNC RESET: the knob runs 0..441 and holds every BPM twice: 241..441 is a twin copy (BPM = screen - 201; both copies show the BPM). Default 120. FOLLW (0..39): follows the bar sync sent by an effect in an earlier slot, its BPM (120 until one is heard, the last one kept if it goes away) and its bars. On a BPM it ignores that and runs on its own. In slots 1-3 FOLLW needs Mozaic's Send knob on another slot.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry synth / choir, DJ style: dry full up to 50, choir full from 50, both full at 50. Default 70.
